messages.subject: Pinnacle House - status and engrossment
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We're at agreed form on the lease after accepting the tenant's three points (six-month break notice, 28-day forfeiture, 3% interest). Client has approved. I'll engross the lease and rent deposit deed and serve the contracting-out notice this week, aiming for exchange w/c 26 August and completion on 29 September. Lender consent from Clydesford is the only open item.

Elena
